title: School front office
description: A school front office with visitor reception, staff printing and filing, a homework lounge and a semi-open office.

tasks.text: Pick up the closed blue-and-black binder at the front-left of the work table, directly in front of the letter tray. Lay it flat near the middle of the same front edge, directly in front of the hole punch.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the closed blue-and-black binder
Lay it flat in front of the hole punch

tasks.text: Find the freestanding brochure holder on the floor beside the reception counter, near the smaller holder on the counter. Push the floor holder 20 cm toward the entrance doors, leaving it upright.

locatorSteps.label: Push the floor holder 20 cm toward the entrance
Leave the holder upright

tasks.text: At the east-wall file cabinet closest to the mail cubby, open the middle drawer. Lift the front hanging folder clear of the rails, hang it back in front of the second folder, then close the drawer with both folders inside.

locatorSteps.label: Open the middle drawer nearest the mail cubby
Lift the front folder clear of the rails
Rehang it on the rails ahead of the other folder
Close the drawer with both folders inside

tasks.text: Find the height-adjustable desk in the separate office with two chairs facing it. Press its up control to raise the desktop to standing height. Keep the cables connected, then use the down control to return it to its original sitting height and release the button.

locatorSteps.label: Press up to raise the connected desk to standing height
Press down to restore sitting height, then release

tasks.text: Find the large printer against the back wall between the supply cabinet and the bookcases. On the printer’s left side, move the release lever to retract the latch and swing the jam-access cover fully open. Close the cover, then return the lever to its starting position.

locatorSteps.label: Move the left-side release lever to unlatch the cover
Swing the jam-access cover fully open
Close the jam-access cover
Return the lever to its starting position

tasks.text: Face the two-door supply cabinet on the back wall to the left of the printer. Open the left door first, then the right, until the stocked shelves are exposed. Close the right door, then the left, and leave both shut.

locatorSteps.label: Open the left cabinet door
Open the right door to expose the shelves
Close the right door
Close the left door

tasks.text: Hold the base of the stapler on the work table, beside the hole punch. Lift its head and slide the staple magazine out to expose the loading channel. Slide the magazine fully back in, then lower and release the head.

locatorSteps.label: Steady the base and lift the stapler head
Slide the staple magazine out
Slide the magazine all the way back in
Lower and release the head

tasks.text: Face the mail cubby beside the row of file cabinets. Take the loose manila folder from the left column, third shelf from the bottom. Lay it on the clear front-right part of the work table, directly in front of the binding machine, and release it.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the manila folder from the cubby’s third shelf
Lay it flat in front of the binding machine

tasks.text: Steady the hole punch on the work table between the stapler and the binding machine. Slide its paper guide to the left stop, then press the handle until the pins descend. Release the handle so the pins rise and return the guide to its starting position.

locatorSteps.label: Steady the punch and slide the guide fully left
Press the handle until the pins descend
Release the handle so the pins rise
Return the guide to its starting position

tasks.text: Hold the binding machine steady at the right end of the work table. Slide the paper-edge guide to the left stop, then move the side lever until the comb rack and fingers open. Return the lever to close the rack and fingers, then reset the guide.

locatorSteps.label: Steady the machine and slide the guide fully left
Move the side lever to open the comb fingers
Return the lever to close the rack and fingers
Reset the paper-edge guide

mobility.basis: Structural source joint inventory; free-body movement and task success not tested by this export.

previewPolicy.method: Preserve source geometry; exclude exterior backdrops from initial framing. Oversized architecture crossing a source-derived room footprint is partitioned into room/backdrop triangles with interpolated UVs and normals.
